title: Reverse Pairs
description: Count the number of reverse pairs where nums[i] > 2 * nums[j] and i < j.
pseudocode:
1. count = 0
2. mergeSort(nums, 0, n-1)
3. function mergeSort(arr, left, right):
4.   if left >= right return
5.   mid = floor((left + right) / 2)
6.   mergeSort(arr, left, mid)
7.   mergeSort(arr, mid + 1, right)
8.   countPairs(arr, left, mid, right)
9.   merge(arr, left, mid, right)

steps.note: Initialize global reverse pair count to 0.
Recursively call mergeSort on left subarray [1].
Recursively call mergeSort on right subarray [3, 2].
Count reverse pairs between [3] and [2]. 3 > 2*2 is false.
Compare index 1 and 2: 3 > 2*2 is false. Final count remains 0.
Merge subarrays back into sorted order.
